notes.title: Advanced(R-stick) Rotation added / Fixed Stage 1-7 Loading Issue
notes.content:
[h1]1. New Gunship Rotation Control Option: Advanced(R-stick) Rotation added[/h1]

With the feedback from flight simulation loving players, we are adding new control option for the advanced players.
Now you can select [b][Advanced(R-stick) Rotation][/b] from the Options Menu to rotate the gunship using the R-stick.

[b]*Warning:[/b] Default control option [b][Head-Movement Rotation][/b] is the optimized rotation control option to reduce VR nausea.
[b][Head-Movement Rotation][/b] stimulate player’s rotation sensory with head tilt movement to reduce the nausea caused from free rotation in VR.
We recommend every player to use [b][Head-Movement Rotation][/b].
[b][Advanced(R-stick) Rotation][/b] is only recommended for flight simulation lovers and advanced VR users who want immersion over comfort.
[b][Advanced(R-stick) Rotation][/b] can cause nausea if the player doesn’t have a lot of experience in VR.


[h1]2. Fixed Stage 1-7(Episode 01-Stage 07) Loading Issue[/h1]

Issue with Stage 1-7 not loading properly fixed.
